positive_generation.graph: binary union of released meta-path projections, with self loops removed
positive_generation.candidate_pool: all non-self union neighbors, identical across strategies
positive_generation.cosine: raw row-normalized supplied target attributes; unavailable semantic evidence for identity inputs
positive_generation.underfull_rows: retain min(8, nonself degree); no outside-pool padding
positive_generation.training: existing full-model selected learning rate, fixed 600 maximum epochs, patience 40 after at least 60 epochs; five frozen probes per encoder
positive_generation.selection: no labels and no test-dependent strategy or hyperparameter selection
positive_generation.implementation_status: newly completed explicit implementation, not verified reconstruction of missing historical generator
positive_generation.preprocessing_profile: measure graph construction, SimRank and ranking before training on otherwise idle GPU

heldout_transfer.partition: each raw node type independently assigned to source or heldout; retain relations only when both endpoints have the same owner
heldout_transfer.empty_neighbor_rule: remove target nodes missing any type required by typed aggregation; filter using structure only
heldout_transfer.projections: rebuild from each graph's original type relations; never slice released full-graph projections or positives
heldout_transfer.positive_rule: fixed graph-local normalized-union ranking, up to eight nonself neighbors plus self
training_settings: source-only self-supervision and frozen heldout deployment
heldout_transfer.learning_rate: fixed original dataset base rate; no full-graph validation-selected rate reused
heldout_transfer.encoder_checkpoint: training loss only; no target labels or metrics select source checkpoint
heldout_transfer.probe_split: 20 training labels and 10 validation labels per class; remaining heldout targets used for test
heldout_transfer.deployment: retain only target attribute projection and meta-path encoder; no target-gradient update in frozen transfer condition
heldout_transfer.scope: heldout non-overlapping graphs within each supplied dataset, not cross-dataset or graph foundation modeling
heldout_transfer.upstream_attribute_boundary: fixed supplied paper attribute dictionary; no fitting across the partition; unknown historical paper feature construction remains a declared input boundary
heldout_transfer.prohibited: no split reselection or hyperparameter tuning based on target test outcomes
heldout_transfer.dblp_attribute_protocol: DBLP-L: after graph separation, independently compute binary support of local PA.T @ local paper-feature support in the common 4231-column vocabulary, followed by row normalization; do not read released author features
heldout_transfer.attribute_decision_basis: before encoder runs: raw-file audit found 48/334 released author-attribute columns identical to full-graph paper aggregation, with no complete reconstruction recipe; graph-local reconstruction removes cross-boundary aggregation
heldout_transfer.partition_algorithm: One NumPy default_rng(20261010), sequential default-int64 integers(0,2,size=n) draws in ACM p/a/s order and DBLP a/p/c/t order; each node independently Bernoulli(0.5). No fixed-size permutation.
